Commentary.Commentary: It's a sorry looking scorecard for Sri Lanka. They have spoiled all the good work done by their bowlers on the first day. Leaving alone Kusal Perera and Dimuth Karunaratne to an extent, the upper order batsmen flopped miserably. Now the onus is back on their bowlers to produce something spectacular once again, so that they won't have to chase too many. How will South Africa fare second time with the willow? Do join us in a short while to find out.

Dale Steyn is leading his teammates off the park and TEA has been taken as well on Day 2. Great effort from the speedster as he bagged a 4-wicket haul and looked very threatening. The rest of the bowlers were also brilliant and apart from that phase post Lunch when the 9th wicket partnership was happening, they always were on top.

All over for Sri Lanka in this innings. But before we say anything else, just stand and applaud for Lasith Embuldeniya. The debutant showed a lot of character in his 94-minute stay in the middle where he took many blows on his body but that didn't stop him from fighting. Along with Kasun Rajitha, he frustrated the South African bowlers in the afternoon and courtesy the efforts of that pair, the deficit has come down to 44.

OUT! A very resilient fight from the debutant comes to an end. Fuller in length from Rabada, Embuldeniya looks to go aerial over the cover region but gets no timing on it. Dale Steyn at covers, moves to his right and takes the catch with his fingers pointing skywards. The young man can go back with his head held high. Also, it's mixed emotions for Dale Steyn, he took the catch of a wicket which would have given him his fifer instead. Sri Lanka bowled out for 191.
Full and straight outside off, Emuldeniya looks to defend but the ball goes under his bat.
Shorter in length, Vishwa has no interest in getting on its way and he ducks underneath it.
Fast and straight outside off on a length, Fernando hangs his bat out like a pendulum but it once again misses.
Full and straight on middle and leg, Vishwa defends it with a straight bat.
Good length delivery outside off, Fernando gets on his back foot and looks to hit it to the off side but misses.
A number 11 kind of play and miss this. Back of a length delivery outside off, Fernando looks to hit it through the line in an unorthodox manner but misses.
Bouncer on middle and off, Fernando gets underneath that one and lets it go to the keeper.
Outside off, Lasith fails to put any bat on this.
FOUR! Gets one wide and puts it away. Outside off, Embuldeniya swings and carves it through backward point for a boundary.
Full and on the stumps, Embuldeniya hits it back to Steyn.
Bouncer on the body. Embuldeniya takes his eyes off the ball but still manages to move away from the line.
Yorker wide outside off, Embuldeniya cannot get bat to ball.
Down the leg side, Fernando tucks it away for one but the umpire signals it as a leg bye.
Back of a length on middle, Embuldeniya keeps it out.
Length delivery outside off, Lasith has a go at it but misses.
Bouncer! Lasith gets down in time and lets it go.
OUCH! That is painful. Full length delivery outside off, Embuldeniya drives it hard. The ball travels at a fast speed and hits Aiden Markram who is standing at silly point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Embuldeniya pushes it to the fielder at point.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Bouncer down the leg side, Fernando sways away from the line.
Outside off, played down to point for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Vishwa Fernando is the last batsman.

OUT! Run out! Great reflexes shown by Aiden Markram at short leg. This surely is against the run of play for the Saffas. They were frustrated to the core by the 9th wicket partnership and have finally managed to break it. A length ball is angled into the batsman, Rajitha flicks it in front of short leg and steps out of his crease in the process. Markram collects the ball quickly, is alert to the situation and scores a direct hit at the striker's end to find Kasun short. All that happened very quickly. This pair batted for 11 overs and added 32 to bring the deficit down to 51.
Quicker one on off, on a shortish length, Rajitha's bat face opens at the point of contact and it goes towards the point fielder.
That missed the outside edge and the off pole by an inch. A good length ball on off, angling back in, Rajitha sticks back to poke inside the line but misses.
Good length delivery outside off, Embuldeniya looks to hit it through the line but misses.
On the leg side, Rajitha looks to flick but it comes off his thigh and they steal a leg bye.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Frustration continues for South Africa. Length delivery on middle and off, Rajitha looks to tuck it to the leg side but it comes off his gloves. The ball falls away from Bavuma, who is standing at silly point.
Shorter length delivery by Steyn, Rajitha gets on top of the bounce and hits it through square leg. He gets a brace for it.
Steyn bowls it down the leg side, Rajitha looks to flick but misses.
Play and miss. Length delivery outside off, Embuldeniya looks to push it away but misses.
Pitches it on length around off, Lasith looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Bouncer. On middle and off, the debutant sits underneath it and lets it go.
Length delivery on off, Lasith pushes it to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Embuldeniya blocks it away.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, Lasith defends it.
Kagiso Rabada back on.
Good running this. Good length delivery around off, Embuldeniya plays it with soft hands towards point and they steal a single.
Length delivery outside off, Lasith lets the ball go to de Kock.
Ouch! Shorter in length on middle and leg. Embuldeniya once again is early on his duck and this time the ball hits him on his helmet.

Dropped. Elgar has dropped a very simple catch here and Steyn looks furious. Back of a length delivery on off, Rajitha looks to defend it but gets an outside edge. The ball goes to the right of the gully fielder. Dean Elgar moves across to take it but the ball pops out of his hands and he fails to take it on the rebound as well. The batsmen meanwhile pick up a single. Would have been a fifer for Dale.
Painful. Shorter in length on leg side, Rajitha looks to defend but takes his eyes off the ball. It hits him on his shoulder.
Good length delivery on middle, Embuldeniya defends it with soft hands towards cover and takes a single.

Drinks break. A very frustrating hour of play for South Africa. They though got the wickets of Suranga Lakmal and Kusal Perera, Kasun Rajitha and debutant Lasith Embuldeniya have hung in there. The deficit has also come down under 60.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Rajitha looks to defend it. It is in the air after hitting high on his bat but he is safe.
Length delivery on the stumps, Rajitha blocks it off his back foot.
Length delivery down the leg side. Rajitha attempts a flick but is nowhere near it.
Length delivery outside off, Embuldeniya pushes it to cover and takes a run.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Lasith defends it.
Close! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Embuldeniya looks to play it with a slanted bat towards third man region. The ball goes just over the outside edge.
On the pads, Lasith flicks it away towards square leg and picks a run.
On middle and leg, Embuldeniya looks to play it but gets a leading edge which falls in no man's land.
Defended off the back foot by Lasith.

FOUR! Edged but they will take it. Good length delivery outside off, Embuldeniya looks to push it but gets an outside edge and the ball races away through the vacant gully region for a boundary. This is frustrating for South Africa.
FOUR! This is a great shot from Embuldeniya. Length delivery outside off, Lasith cuts it through point and the ball races away to the fence.
Good length delivery on the body of Embuldeniya. He plays a half-pull shot and the ball lobs to the off side but in an empty space.
Bouncer. It is on leg stump line, Rajitha jumps and looks to keep it down but it strikes his arm-guard.
Back of a length around off, Lasith plays it to point with a slanted bat for a run.
Good length delivery outside leg, Embuldeniya looks to flick it away but misses.
Once again it is on the pads, this time Kasun flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. Crucial runs these for the visitors.
Length delivery on the pads, Rajitha flicks it away through backward square leg and gets a couple.
Length delivery on middle, Kasun jumps and then defends it towards cover.

Great delivery but no reward. Steyn gets a shortish ball around off to move away just a shade off the seam. Too good for a lower order batsman. Lasith just hangs back to push inside the line and misses.
Shortish and on middle, blocked from the crease by Embuldeniya.
Shortish and on middle, Rajitha helps it off his back foot past short leg for one.
A silly point comes in now. There's already a short leg in place.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rajitha reaches out for it and keeps it out from the crease.
Shortish and on off, defended off the back foot by Rajitha.
The batsman does well to stand tall and play that short delivery.
Swing and a miss. Good length delivery outside off, Lasith looks to pull it away but misses his shot. The ball misses the outside edge by just a whisker.
Down the leg side this time. Lasith looks to flick it but misses.
Beautiful delivery. An attempted inswinging yorker on middle and leg, Rajitha does really well to get his bat down in time. The ball goes towards mid on and they take a single.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Kasun defends it off his back foot.
Length delivery on middle and off, Rajitha tries to defend it, he does so but from the upper half of the bat.
Good length delivery outside off, Kasun looks to push it but misses.
Once again shorter in length, Embuldeniya gets away from the line.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, Lasith keeps it out.
Vicious this. Shorter in length, Embuldeniya looks to get away from it but the ball comes onto him and hits him on his gloves.
Fuller in length, Embuldeniya pushes it to the fielder at mid off.
Good length outside off, Rajitha pushes it towards cover-point and takes a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Duanne is turning out to be a one-length bowler. Embuldeniya throws his bat it and edges it over the slip cordon for a boundary. Deficit is 74!
Well taken by de Kock! A short ball down the leg side, Lasith tries flicking but misses. The ball swings late and Quinton does well to collect it to his left after moving to the right initially.
Nicely played. Angling away from the batsman, Embuldeniya taps it down through point and Maharaj gives the chase. They take two and the debutant is off the mark.
Again it's shortish and on middle, not rising much, Rajitha takes his front leg up and pushes it towards mid on for one.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Rajitha pushes at it tamely and misses.
Goes on the back foot and punches it behind point for a couple.
Bouncer. A fierce short ball to finish off the over. Lasith does well to get away from it. A wicket maiden for Steyn.
Length delivery outside off, Embuldeniya looks to play it but misses.
Good length delivery, Lasith keeps it out.
Kasun Rajitha is in next.

OUT! Steyn hunts down his fourth victim and it's a big wicket also. Going aerial has not worked for Kusal Perera this time. Full length delivery outside off, makes space to hammer it over the infield on the off side but mistimes it completely in the air. The substitute fielder, Zubayr Hamza moves across to his left from extra cover and takes the catch with ease. Faf du Plessis' ploy of pushing the fielders behind has worked here.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Kusal defends it.
In the air but safe. Fuller length delivery outside off, Kusal hits it over mid off and short of the fielder at long off. Embuldeniya comes for a single but he is sent back.
Length delivery on middle and leg. A very expected line from Olivier, Embuldeniya keeps it out.
This time it is a bouncer and Lasith can get under this one.
Ouch! Embuldeniya is leaving painfully here. Back of a length delivery on middle, Lasith looks to duck but the ball strikes him on his arm.
Once again length delivery, Lasith manages to keep it out.
Good length delivery on middle, Embuldeniya defends it with a straight bat.
Shorter in length, Lasith sits underneath it.

FOUR! What a way to bring up his fourth Test fifty. Length delivery on middle, Kusal rocks onto his back foot and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He's Sri Lanka's last hope and is trying out to eat as many runs as possible from the deficit.
Fast bouncer now. On middle and leg, Kusal ducks underneath it. The umpire signals first one for the over.
Full and straight this time by Steyn. This is bowled slower, Perera looks to hit it to the off side but gets beaten by the change of pace.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Kusal defends it.
FOUR! Hammered. Back of a  length delivery on middle and off, Kusal pulls it and pulls it hard over backward square leg for a boundary. Justifies his decision to not take a single.
Length delivery from 'round the wicket. The ball comes in with the angle and hits the inner half of Perera's bat. It then goes to deep square leg but Kusal does not take a single.
A touch short and around leg, Lasith clips it off his pads past the leg gully fielder. No run taken as Perera wants to keep strike.
Beautiful delivery to beat the edge. This one is angled across the debutant, on a good length, Embuldeniya pushes inside the line and misses.
Angling down the leg side, Kusal nudges it fine down to fine leg and this time time decides to cross.
Wide called for height. Olivier digs in a short ball and it goes well over the batsman who shapes up to hook it. The ball travels over his bat and the keeper collects it with a jump.
A touch short and around leg, Kusal is on top of the bounce as he blocks it back safely.
Straighter in line, Perera works it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Short delivery down the leg side, Perera turns inside the crease and pulls it down to fine leg. Turns down the single.

OUCH! Back of a length delivery on middle and off. The ball does not bounce much. Embuldeniya ducks early and the ball strikes his helmet. Aiden Markram walks up to him from short leg and checks on him. Lasith also has a look at his helmet. Everything looks fine and he has not been hurt.
Fast and straight on a length outside off. Embuldeniya lets it be.
Good length delivery outside off, Embuldeniya has no interest in playing that.
Bouncer this time and Lasith ducks underneath it.
Welcomes Embuldeniya with a length delivery outside off. The batsman leaves it alone.
Debutant Lasith Embuldeniya is the new batsman.

OUT! Steyn removes Lakmal in no time. Delivers a length ball on off at 142 kph, Suranga probably tries to flick it on the leg side but fails to close the face of his bat in time. It pops out off the leading edge and Markram takes a simple catch at short cover. Kusal Perera is running out of partners. Sri Lanka's deficit is 93!
Dale Steyn back into the attack.
Once again a shorter ball by Oliver. Lakmal has no control on this pull shot but the top edge falls away from the fielder at square leg and he takes a single.

In the air but safe.  Shorter in length, Perera looks to pull but gets a top edge. The ball goes to the on side. De Kock gives it a chase and dives to catch it but cannot reach there. They take a single.
Chipped but safe. Length delivery on middle and leg, Lakmal pulls it over the fielder at mid-wicket and gets a single.
Back of a length on middle and off, Suranga defends it.
Bouncer! Lakmal reacts quickly and ducks underneath it.
Lakmal is off the mark. Good length delivery outside off, Lakmal cuts it through point and gets a couple.

FOUR! What a start. Perera is on it straight up. First ball after Lunch, Rabada bowls it full outside off. Kusal blazes his drive through covers for a boundary. Excellent stroke to start the post lunch session. He timed it to perfection.
We are back for the afternoon session, Kusal Perera will be joined by Suranga Lakmal. Kagiso Rabada will finish off the over. Perera will be on strike...
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

Duanne Olivier and Kagiso Rabada didn't let the intensity drop after the first hour and bagged a wicket apiece to leave Sri Lanka tottering at 133/6, still behind by 102 runs. Kusal Perera is still unbeaten and has played his shots in a well-constructed knock of 37 and the hosts will be hoping that the lower order sticks around with him after the break. Do join us in a short while for more action.

84/5 in the morning session and South Africa have made a resounding comeback on Day 2. Their pacers were right on the money this morning and didn't waste much time in removing both the overnight batsmen. However, they were a shade lucky in doing that. Oshada Fernando got a rash lbw decision which he didn't refer while Dimuth Karunaratne departed due to the umpire's call. Kusal Perera and Kusal Mendis tried adopting the attacking approach but it didn't work for long as the latter was dismissed by Philander. Yet another partnership developed after that but that got broken just before the end of the morning session.

OUT! A wicket on the stroke of Lunch. That is not great cricket. Very poor from Dhananjaya de Silva. The trap was set and he just walks into it. The fine leg fielder was brought squarer and he should have known that. Rabada releases a short ball on middle, at 146 kph, Dhananjaya takes on the challenge to pull it but the ball takes the top edge and flies in the air at deep backward square leg. Olivier moves across to his left, keeps his eyes glued to the ball and grabs it with his fingers pointing skywards. De Silva has a dejected look on his face. He has only himself to blame for this. With that, the umpires have decided to take Lunch on Day 2.
This time Kagiso Rabada loses his footings and pulls out. Faf du Plessis takes this opportunity to shuffle his field. He brings Duanne Olivier a lot squarer from fine leg.
Outside off, played down from the crease to gully.
Good length ball on off, de Silva defends it from the inner half of his blade.
Dhananjaya de Silva pulls out at the last moment. Kagiso Rabada will have to reload. Poor guy. He was almost at the point of delivering.
Beats the stumps by a whisker. Good length ball on middle, Kusal brings his bat down to defend but it takes the inside edge and scoots past the leg pole for a run at fine leg.
A length ball on off, Perera gets on the front foot and pushes it to short extra cover.
Floated and full on off, de Silva leans forward and defends it easily.
Tossed up ball outside off, de Silva pushes it with an angled bat behind point for a couple.
Arm ball on middle, skidding in, Dhananjaya tries defending again but it takes the inside edge and goes wide of short leg.
Lunges and defends it watchfully.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to short leg.
Flighted ball on off, it's worked with the spin through square leg for a run.
Keshav Maharaj is introduced into the attack with Lunch around the corner. The local lad will want to get a wicket to his name before the break.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper. 9 coming from this over. Sri Lanka's deficit is 106!
FOUR! Runs are coming thick and fast now. This partnership is worth 39. Dhananjaya fetches a short ball from outside off and pulls it with authority to the deep mid-wicket fence.
FOUR! Streaky. A good length ball on off, straightening off the seam, Dhananjaya tries defending from the crease but it takes the outside edge and speeds down to third man for a boundary.
A length ball on off, staying low, Dhananjaya crouches and defends it.

What happened there? Rabada bangs in a short ball around middle and leg, Perera decides to duck but keeps his bat hanging like a periscope. It deflects off his bat to fine leg and they cross. Kusal is quite lucky, it could have gone anywhere.
On a length around off, it's blocked off the back foot to covers.

FOUR! Easy-peasy! Short delivery sliding down the leg side at 143 kph, de Silva turns inside the crease and plays the pull shot. Fails to middle it but whatever connection he has made, it has taken the ball to the fine leg fence.
Targets the rib cage with a short ball, Kusal drops it down with soft hands. It rolls behind square leg and they cross. The replays show that it came off his gloves.
Fractionally short and around off, angling in, de Silva gets back and turns it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, Dhananjaya leaps on the back foot and keeps it down on the leg side.
The length remains short but this time the line is wide outside off. De Silva cracks it off his back foot but finds the point fielder.
A touch short and outside off, Dhananjaya punches it off his back foot to extra cover and straightaway screams 'noooo' as his partner was eyeing a run.
Swing and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Perera tries to pull it over mid-wicket, the shorter part of the ground, but fails to make any connection.
Short in length outside off, angling away, Perera punches it on the up through covers. Maharaj chases it down and keeps them down to a couple.
Too full in length on middle, de Silva leans across and flicks it behind square leg for a single.
Lands it on a length just outside off, Dhananjaya remains back and defends it to the off side.
Better line. It's around off on a length, de Silva gets behind it in defense.
A little short and angling down the leg side, Dhananjaya tries to glance it off his hips but fails to connect.
Stays back to push at it and it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Pitches it up and around off, Kusal drives but finds the fielder at cover-point.
Good length delivery on middle and off, blocked back from the crease.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Olivier is on the shorter side again but the line is wide outside off, Perera jumps on his back foot and slams it over point for a boundary.
This one is served on a length around middle, Perera pushes it out from the crease to mid off.
Wayward delivery. Bouncer down the leg side. Perera has nothing to do with it. The length was right not the line. The field is set for short-pitch bowling. A fine leg and deep square leg in place.
Back of a length delivery on off, defended off the back foot to end the over.
Short and down the leg side, Dhananjaya tries his best to get some wood behind it but misses.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.

SIX! That has gone all the way. Sometimes the excessive pace works against you. Rabada bangs in a short ball on middle at 142 kph, Dhananjaya takes on the challenge to pull it and the ball flies off the top edge. Clears fine leg with ease.
Gets squared up this time. On a good length around off at 145 kph, straightening a touch, de Silva gets opened up in defense and it goes off the outer half of his bat to point.
Hits the timber, at the opposite end. A fullish ball on middle and off, Dhananjaya plays a delightful straight drive but it's so straight that it takes the stumps at the other end.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Awkward pulling. Olivier is quite predictable with his length. Dhananjaya tries to get inside the bounce and then pulls it down to fine leg. A good acrobatic diving stop in the deep by Rabada and he saves two runs for his team.
Nearly gets into action. A rising delivery around leg, Dhananjaya fends it down and it goes on one bounce to the short leg fielder.
A bat-pad in place.
Bowls a shorter one on middle, Perera gets on top of the bounce and pulls it to deep square leg for a single. 100 comes up for Sri Lanka. They trail by another 135 runs.
Digs in another bouncer, this time on the middle stump line, Perera ducks.
A bouncer around leg, Perera sits underneath it.
Overpitched ball on off, it's driven in front of mid off for a quick single.
Hits the yorker mark on off, Perera keeps his eyes glued to the ball as he digs it out safely.
Goes on the back foot and punches it through extra cover for a brace.

SIX! Up and over Keshav Maharaj. Perera won't die wondering. He fetches a length ball from outside off and swings it powerfully over square leg. There is a fielder in the deep who jumps but it sails over his head. That was bowled at 144 kph. Fighting fire with fire.
A length ball on middle and off, Perera defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Very full and sharp outside off, Perera chases and misses.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, de Silva goes on his toes to play it towards square leg. Not sure it went off his thigh pad or the bat.
A back foot defense by Dhananjaya.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Bouncer, the new batsman lets it go over his head.
Dhananjaya de Silva comes in at number 7.

OUT! And Duanne Olivier takes just two balls to strike. He dishes out his favourite shorter delivery around middle and leg at 141 kph, Dickwella initially shapes up for the pull shot and tries to help it on the leg side. But it takes the splice of his bat before ballooning in the air towards third man. Dale Steyn runs across to his left in the deep and takes the simplest of catches. Yet another blow to the Sri Lankans.
Starts his spell from over the wicket and slips a length ball down the leg side. Niroshan tries to flick but misses.
Duanne Olivier replaces Vernon Philander in the attack.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Beaten this time! Rabada angles a length ball across the southpaw, Perera has a needless push inside the line and misses. If he keeps on bowling this line, he will soon get the reward, feels Michael Holding (on air).
Play and a miss. Beaten by sheer pace. Short and wide outside off at 145 kph, Perera tries to slap it down the ground but fails to make any connection.
Shorter one down the leg side, Kusal gets into an awkward position and somehow nudges it behind in the direction of fine leg. A couple taken this time.
This one is angled across the batsman, on a good length, Dickwella pushes at it with an angled bat and runs it down through backward point. Bavuma chases it down and they take three runs.
Keeps it full and on middle, Dickwella gets behind the line and blocks it back to the bowler.
Gets back and flicks it off the inside half of the bat through backward square leg. A single is taken.

FOUR! Edgy way to get off the mark. An inswinger on this occasion, landing on a length around middle, Dickwella tries to defend from the back foot but it takes the inside edge and runs fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Edged but didn't carry! Philander bowls an outswinger on the middle stump line, Dickwella is squared up in defense and edges it behind. Doesn't carry to du Plessis at second slip.

Misfield but no run. A full length ball outside off, Dickwella drives it off his front foot to covers where the fielder misfields and parries it to mid off. Niroshan initially looks for a run but the mid off reacts quickly and the striker aborts his move.
Around leg, on a length, some extra bounce, Dickwella tries to flick but misses and is hit high on the pads.
Nearly drags it on. Philander cannot believe his luck. He serves a length ball on off, Niroshan gets forward to defend but it takes the inside edge and hits him on the back leg.

Drinks break. South Africa take the first hour after striking thrice. They still have a 155-run lead and would be looking to run through the fragile-looking Sri Lankan batting line-up. For the visitors, they have two stroke players in the middle and if they stay for an hour or so, runs will surely flow. It promises to be an entertaining next hour.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it to covers. End of the over. Only a boundary from it.
Good take, de Kock! Rabada bends his back to go short, digs it around middle and Perera tries to pull it. But it goes over his bat and Quinton jumps to collect it with one hand.
Mistimed. A length ball on middle and off, angling away, Perera tries pushing through the line but it catches the inner half of his bat and rolls back to the bowler.
Angling away from the batsman, on a length, Perera pushes it to the off side, not in the gap.
Good length delivery on middle and off, sharp pace, Perera blocks it solidly off his back foot to covers.
FOUR! Aerial but in the gap! Perera will play his shots no matter what! A pitched up delivery outside off, Kusal plays a big booming drive through covers for a boundary.
Kagiso Rabada to bowl.
Angles a length ball across the batsman. It's outside off and left alone by Niroshan. A good take by Quinton.
A length ball around off, it's defended from the back foot.
Niroshan Dickwella walks out to the middle. Quinton de Kock is standing up to the stumps now to restrict Dickwella's movement.

OUT! Edged and gone! Fine diving catch by Faf du Plessis, his 50th in Tests. Philander has his second wicket. He repeats the last delivery but this time from the middle stump line. It nips away after pitching on a shortish length. Mendis is squared up in his back foot defense and it takes the outside edge before flying behind. It's dying in front of du Plessis at second slip but he goes down immediately to grab it inches above the surface. Big blow to Sri Lanka as they lose arguably their best batsman in the line-up. They trail by 159 runs.
Well bowled! A touch short around off and shaping away a shade, Mendis has a nervous poke inside the line and misses.
Good length ball on middle, it's turned behind square leg for a single.
Some extra bounce visible again. Around leg, Perera tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Oohhh...this one stops a bit onto the batsman after landing on a length around middle. Mendis is a bit early into his push and it goes aerially towards mid on. Doesn't carry. 18 from the last two overs, definitely their approach is to attack.

EDGY FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard. Any width on offer outside off and they are going after it. It's short and wide outside off, Mendis throws his bat at it and it flies wide of the slip cordon for a boundary.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
On a length around off, some extra bounce, Mendis does well to negotiate it with gentle bottom hand as he keeps it out safely to the off side.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! Three in three for Sri Lanka. The Lankan batsmen have decided to follow the aerial route. A length ball outside off, Mendis leans forward and lofts it over mid off. The fielder gives the chase but the ball wins the race.
FOUR! Better than the last one. More in control. Philander continues to offer width outside off, Perera packs a punch and rifles it down through mid off for a powerful boundary.
FOUR! That's a Twenty20 shot! Philander pitches it up and outside off, plenty of room there, Perera just reaches out for it and lifts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Around off on a good length, angling away, Perera stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to the off side.
Flashes and misses! Philander puts it short and wide outside off, Perera tries to crack it through the line but fails to connect.
Outstanding leave. Trusting the bounce. A length ball around off, Perera strides forward and shoulders arms. It goes just over the off pole.
A touch short in length and outside off, Perera is on top of the bounce as he punches it through covers. Bavuma chases it down near the fence and they take a couple of runs.
Steyn gets closer to the off stump this time. Back of a length ball, Mendis goes on his toes to defend it to the off side.
Way wide outside off, the length is also short, Mendis is in no mood to play at those.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
An away swinger on this occasion. Steyn lands it outside off and it's an easy leave for Mendis.
Good length delivery this time, in the region outside off and shapes back in a little, Mendis takes his front leg to cover his stumps and then shoulders arms.
Speedy bouncer around off, Mendis ducks at the last moment.
The fourth umpire is having a chat with the groundsman near the boundary rope where there are wet patches. He wants those wet covers to be taken off the ground.

Big cry for an lbw! Not given. Philander has a surprised look on his face. An inswinger around leg, Perera tries to flick but misses. He is struck on the pads, the appeal is made but the umpire remains unmoved. No thought over DRS this time.
Gloved onto the pads. A rising delivery on middle, Perera tries to defend but it jumps onto the batsman, takes his gloves and strikes him on the pads.
Perera has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Better this time. Perera watches the line to be too far outside off and makes a leave.
Beaten again! Away movement from the left-hander, Perera is forward to push inside the line but misses. His bat hits the pads and there was some noise. Only de Kock got excited for a while.
Beaten! Angling across the batsman, on a length, Perera is lured into the drive and is beaten.

The ball has gone wet as there was some wet patches near the fence. The umpires are getting it changed. Aahhh... they are taking too much time to choose the cherry. Overrate hasn't been great in this Test, wonder this wastage of time will go in Faf's account or not. He is seen having a word with one of the officials. Finally the replacement ball has been chosen. Now, more delay. What's happening? The Sri Lankan physio runs out. Kusal Mendis is feeling some discomfort near his neck area. All sorted, we can finally resume...
FOUR! Well played! Steyn keeps it nice and full, in the line of the stumps, Mendis thumps his straight drive and beats mid on to the fence. Lovely way to open his account.
Angling into the batsman, Mendis brings down a straight bat and pushes it to mid on.
On middle, a length ball, Mendis flicks a bit uppishly but safely to mid-wicket.
Another delivery in the channel outside off has been left alone by Kusal Mendis.
In the channel outside off, going straight on, no swing for Steyn, Mendis shoulders arms.
Pitches it up and outside off, it's driven but straight to the cover fielder.
Kusal Perera walks out at number 5.

OUT! Philander gets his man this time. It's clipping leg and the umpire's call stays. A fuller length ball around leg, Dimuth leans across to flick it on the leg side but misses. He is thudded on the pads, once again the bowler runs in appeal and then turns to see that the umpire has lifted his finger. The Sri Lankan skipper opts to review it after consulting his partner but this time the technology is with South Africa. It has marginally pitched on the leg stump line and is going on to tickle the leg pole. Both the overnight batsmen are sent packing. A fine start to Day 2 for the hosts.
Another referral. This time Dimuth Karunaratne has been given out lbw. The Lankan skipper wants to get it reviewed after having a chat with his partner. Is pitching an issue?

NOT OUT! Philander delivers a length ball on middle and gets it to nip back into the batsman. Karunaratne tries defending but seems to have missed it. The ball strikes him on the back leg, they appeal but the umpire disagrees. Faf du Plessis gets convinced by his bowler to take the referral, however, Maharaj from square leg gestures that it's high. Now then, the replays roll in and it vindicates Keshav Maharaj. South Africa lose a review.

Huge shout for an lbw! Philander keeps on running in appeal and has almost reached the striker's end. Is it too high? Is there some bat? Faf du Plessis has decided to refer it. Maharaj at square leg feels it's high. Let's see...
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Full in length and on middle, Karunaratne is half-forward as he plays it off his pads to the leg side. Straight to mid-wicket.
Leans forward to a full ball outside off and defends it to the off side.
Short in length and outside off, Dimuth cuts it off his back foot to deep point for a couple of runs.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, holding its line, it's left alone by Kusal again. A wicket maiden for Dale.
Edgy! Steyn lands it on a length around off and it straightens a touch, Mendis looks to defend it with a straight bat but it takes the outer half and goes towards point.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

Here comes the Ball Tracker for the wicket delivery. Oshada Fernando should definitely have gone upstairs. The Hawk Eye shows it was missing the leg pole. The debutant will be disappointed, he was looking good out in the middle. Dimuth Karunaratne should have helped the young man a little better there.
Well bowled. That's not too far away from the off pole. Steyn is in rhythm. Serves a full ball outside off and gets it to shape back in a bit, Kusal makes a brave leave.
Kusal Mendis is the new batsman.

OUT! Steyn appeals and immediately the finger goes up. That's plumb as far as umpire Aleem Dar is concerned. Two for Dale now. He spears in a fuller length ball on middle and leg, angling down, Fernando tries flicking but misses. He is hit on the pads and the finger is up quickly. Dale Steyn is pumped up. The debutant consults his skipper a bit and then walks back. Believe me, that was worth reviewing as it seems to be going down leg. Early breakthrough for the Proteas, just the kind of start they wanted.
Good pace, 140 kph. It's on a length and outside off, Fernando shoulders arms.
Fuller and straighter on middle, at 128 kph, Karunaratne gets behind the line and bunts it to mid on. Philander begins with a maiden.
Good length ball targeting the middle stump line, Dimuth keeps his weight on the back foot and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Puts it on and around off, nice and full, Karunaratne plays it with an angled bat to the off side.

This time Vernon has bowled it full and closer to the off stump line. Dimuth has to play at it and he blocks it down by getting half-forward. On his way back to the bowling mark, Philander just checked his landing area.
Lands it full and outside off, once again angling away from the lefty, Dimuth is in no mood to go after it so early.
Starts with a good length delivery in the zone outside off, angling away, Karunaratne covers the line and shoulders arms.
Good breeze is blowing across the field at the moment. Vernon Philander to share the attack from the other end. He was a shade off colour last evening.
Solid. Steyn fires it in full and on off, Oshada presents a straight willow in defense. Looks like a confident young man.
This one is served wide outside off, a watchful leave made by the debutant.
Slips a full ball down the leg side, Fernando tries flicking but fails to get bat on ball.
Good length ball angling into the batsman from around off, Fernando defends it from the crease to the off side.
Serves it on a length outside off, Oshada is confidently on the front foot as he drives it towards mid off.
Runs straightaway. Steyn is on the pads of the batsman, Oshada flicks it behind square leg and comes back for the second run. 50 up for Sri Lanka.

It's time to get underway. The conditions are overcast and the South African bowlers will love it. A big challenge first up for the Sri Lankan overnight batsmen, Dimuth Karunaratne and Oshada Fernando. Richard Kettleborough and Aleem Dar share a smile as they walk in. They had a tough first day and would look to be on the money today. Dale Steyn is ready to steam in. All set, let's play...

Welcome to the second day of this first Test match between South Africa and Sri Lanka. Against all odds, Sri Lanka are slightly on top at this point of time. They trail South Africa by 186 runs and have lost just 1 wicket so far. The hosts experienced a tough first day and will look to strike early in order to redeem themselves. Needless to say, the wickets will be the key here for both sides. Early morning conditions along with a fairly new ball, there might just be some help for the African pacers. An exciting first session awaits us. Stay tuned for more updates...
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

So, what is in store for Thursday? This surface has provided assistance to the bowlers, especially the faster ones and the hosts will hope that their pace battery uses the early morning conditions to their advantage. It won't be easy for Sri Lanka and they will have to apply themselves really hard. They surely will gain a lot of confidence from today's good work and would look to take the same momentum forward. Do join us at 1000 local (0800 GMT) for all the action. Cheers!

Quinton de Kock is down for an interview. On the start, he opines that it was not a good one but they recovered well. On the track, he reckons that it is slow and seeing spin on the first day, he suggests that Keshav Maharaj should get purchase from it. Also adds that his four seamers should do the job. On his innings, he replies that he got into strong positions and wanted to score runs. Continues saying that he started slowly but eventually caught up. Credits Sri Lanka for the way they bowled.

In reply, Sri Lanka lost Lahiru Thirimanne for a duck but their new captain, Dimuth Karunaratne, batted with good control and along with debutant Oshada Fernando, he is amidst a handy partnership. There were nervy moments but the current pair survived and now will look to build on their innings on Day 2. The hosts tried 6 bowlers to bowl 16 overs and apart from Dale Steyn, there isn't much to talk about their efforts.

End of an outstanding day of Test cricket. Sri Lanka started it in a dominating manner and have ended it in a good position as well. Their pacers, Rajitha and Vishwa, were phenomenal in the first session as they had South Africa on the mat. The Proteas then recovered through the partnership between du Plessis and Bavuma. De Kock took it forward from there and was involved in crucial stands with the lower order which propelled the home side's total to 235.
BAD LIGHT! The umpire is having a look at the light meter and feels it's not good enough to carry on! The players are leaving the field. That will be Stumps on Day 1.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
EDGY FOUR! Loopy and full on middle, Oshada runs down the track for a big heave across the line but it stays low to catch the inside edge as it speeds away to the fine leg fence.
Full and flighted on middle, swept down fine towards short fine leg, another hesitation over a run. They didn't cross.
Short and outside off, Fernando gets back and cuts it late to beat point. Takes a couple of runs.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it back watchfully.
FOUR! Full toss on the body, Karunaratne walks out and lofts this over mid-wicket for an easy boundary.

Oh boy! Yes-No and a missed opportunity! Fernando gets away with one. On leg, Dimuth turns it to the square leg region and thinks of a run. His partner comes charging down but the Lankan skipper hesitates seeing the fielder attacking the ball. Oshada is half-way down the track when he is sent back. Steyn, in the meantime, hurls in a throw to Elgar who fails to collect it cleanly and breaks the stumps with his legs. Had the bowler taken that, Fernando would have been a goner. Big reprieve for the debutant.
On off, driven to covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
BYES! Down leg again, Fernando gets low to sweep but misses it. De Kock fails to collect it and it goes towards fine leg. They come back for the third run.
Off spinner on leg, turned away around the corner for one.
We're into the extended time. Still around 15 overs left in the day's play. Won't get all of them bowled surely.
Dean Elgar is called to bowl.
Gets behind another one and blocks it out.
Covers his stumps and taps it in front of him.
Flighted ball on off, driven to the man at covers.
On the pads, Fernando flicks it off them through square leg for a brace.
Beaten! Off spinner outside off, Fernando looks to play it on the up but gets beaten. Good comeback.
FOUR! What a shot first up! Tossed up ball on middle, Fernando steps out and lofts this nonchalantly over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Keshav Maharaj to roll his arm over.
Short again, pulled away through square leg for a run.
On the body, Fernando goes back and taps it in front of him.
Fernando shows the full face of the bat and keeps another one out.
Duanne's go-to ball. Shorter in line on off. Oshada bunts it down.
Similar length, Fernando plays it out with a straight bat.
Back of a length on off, Fernando does well to block it.
That length! Short on off, Fernando pulls but gets a top edge which doesn't carry to fine leg. They cross.
Length on the stumps, Oshada is solid in his defense.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Fernando does well to keep it down.
Good length around off, kept out by Fernando.
Short ball around off, Fernando pulls but finds the man at mid-wicket.
On the pads, flicked away to the on side for nothing.
Bouncer, Karunaratne ducks at the last minute.
The line is too straight this time. The length remain short and Fernando gets it away off the inside edge to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, defended off the back foot by the debutant.
Goes short on the body, Fernando blocks it with a straight bat.
On the leg side this time, Fernando turns his bat to the leg side.
Starts by bowling one at a back of a length ball on off, Fernando blocks it out.
Duanne Olivier is into the attack.
On a length outside off, Karunaratne punches it from the back foot to cover-point. Rabada begins with a maiden.
In the zone outside off, Dimuth shoulders arms.
Play and a miss! Width on offer outside off, Karunaratne needlessly hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
Goes on the back foot to defend but his bat turns in his hands and he pushes it towards the leg side.
Good length ball around off, angling in, Dimuth gets behind the line and blocks it to the off side.
Rabada runs in from 'round the wicket and serves a gentle length delivery outside off, an easy leave for Karunaratne.
First bowling change. It's Kagiso Rabada who has been unleashed into the attack.
A length ball on off, Karunaratne closes the face of the bat and eases it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Full and in the line of the stumps, DK pushes it to mid on.
Oohhh... a very ambitious attempt from the Sri Lankan skipper. Tries playing a booming cover drive but gets beaten comprehensively. Would have looked very bad had he edged it.
A length ball outside off, pushed from the crease in the gap on the off side for a run. Debutant is off the mark.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Fernando tries to defend from the crease but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Puts it on a fuller length outside off, Karunaratne pushes it off his front foot to covers.
A length ball on off, Dimuth easily works it off his pads through square leg for a couple. So far, the skipper has looked assured at the crease.
A soft outside edge. On a length outside off, Dimuth pushes inside the line with soft hands and it goes off the outside edge to gully. Doesn't carry.
Well played. Leans forward and across to a full ball angled into him and then flicks it wide of mid on for a brace.
Gets behind the line of the delivery around off and blocks it safely.
Karunaratne has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This time Fernando is hurried up as he fends it off in front of short leg. A wicket maiden from Steyn.
Slips a length ball down the leg side, Fernando tries to flick but misses.
Oshada Fernando is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! Poor, very poor from Thirimanne. Steyn angles across a back of a length delivery outside off, at 136 kph, Lahiru flirts with it away from his body, footwork nowhere near to the pitch of the ball and he gets a faint outside edge behind. De Kock makes no mistake and Thirimanne falls for a 15-ball duck. Could have easily left it. Now go back and cool your heels in the dressing room. Very disappointing shot selection from an experienced batsman.
Gloved it, mostly. Short and around leg, Thirimanne tries to leave but is late in taking his hands away. It takes his gloves but lands safely behind square leg.
Back of a length delivery on off, Thirimanne goes on his toes and taps it down towards square leg.
Steams in and serves a good length ball on middle, Thirimanne solidly gets behind the line in defense.
Plays it with the angle of the bowler. Karunaratne stays back and turns a length ball around off through square leg. A couple of runs taken. So far, so good from the Lankan openers.
Play and a miss! Yet another delivery in the channel outside off, this time the batsman feels for it inside the line and gets beaten.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Comes from 'round the wicket for Karunaratne. Angles in a length ball on off, Dimuth work it wide of mid on and collects a couple.

Shout for an lbw! Philander dishes out a length ball on the pads, Thirimanne tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. The bowler appeals while the batsmen cross. Given as a leg bye. Missing leg also.
Strides forward to a full ball and tries to hit it through the line. But it takes the inner edge and rolls to square leg.
A little short in length on middle, defended off the back foot to the on side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Offers a straight bat and drives it down the ground. Duanne Olivier gets to his right from mid on, tries to stop it with a dive but it sneaks through. A couple taken.
Beaten! Back of a length delivery outside off, Dimuth stands back to push inside the line and misses.

Appeal for an lbw! Steyn gets a length ball to skid back into the batsman from outside off. Dimuth fails to keep it out and is hit on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal. Clipping leg, the replays show late.
Angles in a length ball on off, Karunaratne gets behind the line and pushes it with a straight bat to mid on.
Switches his angle and comes to 'round the wicket. Serves a length ball on middle and leg, Dimuth comfortably turns it off his pads through square leg for a run.
Another inswinging delivery, Philander is sticking to his line around off, Dimuth pushes it back from the inner half of his bat. Vernon picks up the ball and mimes a throw.
Pitches it up and around off, staying a shade low too, Karunaratne keeps his eyes glued to the ball and defends it from the bottom half of his bat to mid-wicket.
Dimuth has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around off, on a length, defended off the back foot.

Shout for an lbw, an extended one from Philander but the umpire remains unmoved. A length ball around middle, shaping back in, Karunaratne tries defending but misses and is hit high on the back leg. Going over the stumps, show the replays.
Good length over the off pole, Lahiru blocks it and remains on 0.
This one is around off, Thirimanne is solid in his defense.
Strays down leg, Dimuth works it towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! SHOT! Lovely control. Overpitched it in search of swing. It comes back into Karunaratne who stands tall and just punches it through mid on for a boundary.
Angles this away from the left-hander who shoulders his arms to it.
Bangs it in short down the leg side. Karunaratne looks to pull it but it is too far for him.
In the region outside off, an easy leave for Lahiru to complete the over.
Extra bounce. It lands on a length around off, Thirimanne tries to defend and does so from the shoulder of his bat towards gully. Does well to play it with soft hands.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Karunaratne glances it uppishly off his hips and it goes in the gap at square leg for a run.
Much better line and length from Vernon this time. Keeps it around off and there is a hint of inward shape as well, Dimuth covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
FOUR! Nicely played! Philander is on the shorter side with his length, it's wide outside off, Karunaratne rocks back and smashes it through cover-point to get off the mark.
Starts with a length ball around off, Karunaratne defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Vernon Philander to share the new cherry from the other end.
End of the first over. Length ball on off, Lahiru taps it in front of him.
On middle and leg, Thirimanne looked to play that on the on side but gets a soft leading edge to the off side.
Back of a length ball closer to the stumps, the southpaw bunts it down.
Around of again, Thirimanne gets behind it and sees it out.
Good length ball around off, Thirimanne defends it well.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands it on the leg side. Thirimanne flicks it away to backward square leg for the first run.
